summary: NN, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a letter agreement with Legion Partners Asset Management, following the July 20, 2026 resignation of director Raymond T. White. The company accelerated vesting of 49,079 restricted shares awarded March 18, 2026, and Legion irrevocably waived replacement director rights under the January 16, 2026 cooperation agreement. No price or value was stated. The agreement modifies prior board composition terms. Watch for potential further board changes or activist settlement amendments, though no immediate financial impact is indicated.
